source: The Hindu / Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle
bullets_en: Tributes paid to Rajiv Gandhi recalling his communal peace rally at Charminar.
Six-member sub-committee to tackle El Nino effect in Telangana.
Former Electricity Minister Blames UDF for Keralam Power Tariff Hike.
Historic arch damaged in Hyderabad’s Attapur, AIMIM seeks action.
Actors being targeted for publicity to spread terror: Minister.
bullets_ur: Charminar par aman rally ko yaad karte hue Rajiv Gandhi ko khiraj-e-aqeedat pesh kiya gaya.
Telangana mein El Nino ke asrat se nipatne ko chah rukni zeli committee
Sabqa Electricity Minister ne Keralam mein bijli ke rates mein izafay ka zimmedar UDF ko thehraya.
Hyderabad ke Attapur mein tareekhi arch ko nuqsan, AIMIM ne karrawai ka mutaliba kiya.
Dehshat phelane aur publicity ke liye adakaron ko nishana banaya ja raha hai: Wazir.
